name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Reactor goes with none of Hertz, Otis, or Robotics.
Dam goes with Electrical if and only if Chemical does not go with Hertz.
Exactly one of these is true: Otis goes with $35k; Chemical goes with Reactor; Dam goes with $25k.
Between $20k and $30k, one goes with Ford and the other with Otis.
If either Hertz does not go with $35k or $30k goes with Otis (but not both), then Rover goes with $35k.
The Electrical engineer's budget is lower than both Hertz and the engineer on the Dam.
Watt, Electrical, and Robotics go with Dam, $20k, and $30k, in some order.
